names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 iulie, «Sfântul Ierarh Anatolie, Patriarhul Constantinopolului».

floruit.note: doxologia.ro dates one event of his patriarchate and nothing else: «l-a caterisit la Sinodul al IV-lea a toată lumea de la Calcedon din anul 451». It adds that he shepherded the Church eight years, and gives no year for his enthronement or for his death, so no wider interval is recorded here.
